name: Leg Wound
text: You limp, and it slows you down. -1 Brawn and -1 Wits when you evade. Rest and hope it heals.

outcomes.text: The wound closes clean.
The wound festers. You lose 1 Health.

cure.text: See a doctor: pay 2 Funds to discard it.

name: Cracked Ribs
text: Every breath hurts. -1 Brawn in combat. Rest and hope it heals.

outcomes.text: The ribs knit. You can breathe again.
You turn the wrong way in your sleep. You lose 1 Health.

name: Jungle Fever
text: Sweats, chills, and dreams that feel like memories. -1 Nerve. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: The fever breaks in the small hours.
In the fever you walk a stone city under a green sky. You lose 1 Sanity.
The fever burns hot. You lose 2 Health.

cure.text: Take quinine: pay 1 Funds and test Brawn to discard it.

name: Exhausted
text: Your body begs for sleep. -1 Brawn and -1 Wits. Rest to recover.

outcomes.text: You sleep for fourteen hours and wake up yourself again.

name: Paranoia
text: They are watching. All of them. -1 Charm. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: You hide in your room for a day with the furniture against the door.
You burn your papers so they cannot read them. You lose 1 Clue.
For once you were right. The man following you drops a letter, and you read it.
A long talk with a friend, and the fear loosens its grip.

cure.text: Talk it through: test Nerve to discard it.

name: Night Terrors
text: You dread sleep. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: You wake up screaming. You lose 1 Sanity.
The dream shows you a door, and where it is. You gain 1 Clue.
A dreamless night, at last. The terrors fade.

cure.text: Laudanum and willpower: pay 1 Funds and test Nerve to discard it.

name: Lost Hours
text: You cannot account for whole days. You will find out what you did after your next encounter.

outcomes.text: There is a bloody knife in your coat pocket. The police want to talk to you.
You find pages of notes in your own hand, in a language you do not know. You gain 2 Clues and lose 1 Sanity.
A hotel sends you the bill for a room you do not remember. You lose 2 Funds.
A stranger shakes your hand and thanks you for saving his daughter. He insists on a reward.

name: Unmoored
text: Time slips around you. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: You lose a day entirely.
You come back to yourself in a city you do not remember traveling to.
You see a moment of tomorrow, and it helps you. You gain 1 Clue.

name: Wanted by the Police
text: Your face is on a poster. You cannot raise funds or visit the market. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: The police find you. A night in the cells and a heavy fine.
The heat dies down. A bigger story pushes your face off the front page.

cure.text: Pay off the right sergeant: pay 3 Funds to discard it.

name: Debt to the Kessler Brothers
text: You borrowed money from people who always collect. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: Two men in good suits come to collect.

effects.prompt: Pay the Kesslers what you owe?

else.text: They take it out of your hide instead.

outcomes.text: The brothers are busy with someone else this week.

cure.text: Pay the debt: pay 3 Funds to discard it.

name: Hexed
text: Bad luck sticks to you like tar. -1 to every test. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: The hex lifts as suddenly as it came.
Your luck sours further. Something you own breaks.

cure.text: Burn sage and pray: test Nerve (-1) to discard it.

name: Marked by the Watcher
text: Something has your scent. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: It finds you.
It loses your trail in the crowds.

cure.text: Wash in running water at night: test Lore to discard it.

name: A Bargain in the Dark
text: You owe something you cannot name. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: Payment is due. The world grows a little darker.
Payment is due. It takes part of your mind.
Payment is due. It asks for blood.

name: Blessed
text: Someone is watching over you. +1 to every test. Something may happen at night.

outcomes.text: The blessing fades.

name: Inspired
text: The pieces are coming together. +1 Lore and +1 Wits. It lasts until after your next encounter.

outcomes.text: The insight settles into something solid. You gain 1 Clue.
